title: Unraveling Darkness
subtitle: The Spiral Chronicles · Book I
description: In Altearth, memory, power, and the fierce insistence of the individual meet in an epic fantasy of transformation. The opening book of The Spiral Chronicles invites readers into a world where what is remembered can change what becomes possible.

title: Greystone: Dorian
subtitle: Greystone · Book I
description: A gothic world of family legacy, ancient magic, intimacy, and gathering danger. Dorian begins the Greystone quadrilogy, a literary world also being developed for the screen.

title: The Grynkie Treasury
subtitle: The Wonderful World of Grynkie
description: Small beings. Unexpected courage. A wonderfully large capacity for kindness. Grynkie’s world celebrates curiosity, friendship, mischief, and the quiet magic of little things. Book I is being prepared toward a full-color hardcover proof.

title: Markham
subtitle: Ideas in conversation
description: An encounter with consciousness, perception, and the possibilities of being. Markham brings philosophical inquiry into conversation, opening familiar certainties to unfamiliar questions. Explore the developing conversations at MarkhamIdeas.org.

title: Remembering You’re Extraordinary
status: Book I published (KDP, 2017); Book II in development
subtitle: A life of possibility
description: An invitation to recognize the worth, resilience, and possibility already present within a human life. Book I, How to Survive 45, subtitled Remembering You’re Extraordinary, was published on KDP in 2017. Book II, Remembering You’re Extraordinary, is in progress, a substantially reimagined successor to the first. The Rye House is the book’s literary home.

title: Where Hearts Abide
subtitle: Poetry of love, memory, and belonging
description: A developing poetry collection. The title offers a place to begin: with the bonds we carry, the language of affection, and the traces a life leaves in another.

title: Buttermilk Sandwitch
subtitle: Stories with a mischievous streak
description: A continuing series with published episodes on Substack, bringing storytelling, humor, and an unmistakably playful imagination together. Step into a world whose name is already a warning that things may not proceed quite normally.

title: The Adventures of Joe Thoroughgood
subtitle: Adventure, with complications
description: An adventure series in development. Joe Thoroughgood has a place on the author’s workbench alongside worlds of fantasy, comedy, and the unexpected.

title: The Inheritor
subtitle: From the world of Greystone
description: A short work belonging to the Greystone world. It offers another doorway into the family legacy and gothic atmosphere that underpin the larger book and screen project.

title: The Widow’s Gift
subtitle: A story by R Remy Miller
description: A work of short fiction within R Remy Miller’s wider literary catalogue. Reading and publication links will accompany the work when publicly available.

title: A World of Sovereign Authors
subtitle: Speculative fiction
description: A speculative story from the author’s growing body of short fiction, exploring the worlds that open when imagination encounters questions of sovereignty.

title: Heinous Shadows
subtitle: Dark imaginings
description: A short work from the darker side of the catalogue. R Remy Miller’s fiction moves between the mysterious, the speculative, and the deeply human.

title: The Anatomy of Silence
subtitle: A Chronicle Tale
description: A Chronicle Tale in the author’s short-fiction catalogue, alongside the longer mythic and speculative worlds.

title: The Trouble With Time
subtitle: Fiction, with a temporal complication
description: A short story in the catalogue of R Remy Miller. One more encounter with the possibilities that open when ordinary certainty becomes a little less certain.

title: The Story Standing in Front of the World
subtitle: A named work on the horizon
description: A developing literary project. Its title has a place in the catalogue while its form and fuller public introduction take shape.

title: Where the Words Had Been
subtitle: Selected poetry
description: One of the poems in R Remy Miller’s growing body of verse, alongside Love Leaves Traces and What Children Know.

title: Love Leaves Traces
subtitle: Selected poetry
description: A poem by R Remy Miller, included in the author’s poetry catalogue.

title: What Children Know
subtitle: Selected poetry
description: A poem by R Remy Miller, included in the author’s poetry catalogue.

title: VelvetFire
subtitle: Voice, intimacy, and imagination
description: An experimental voice-led project exploring intimacy, sovereignty, and the possibilities of storytelling across media.

title: Messages of Love & Hope
subtitle: A little more light in the world
description: Short reflections in good cheer, human possibility, compassion, and the ordinary ways we can make life gentler for one another. Follow the author’s public writing on Substack.

title: Reclaiming AI
subtitle: People, meaning, and emerging intelligence
description: An essay series considering AI through human purpose, relationship, and the possibilities of creative and intellectual partnership. Related professional work lives at Horizon Technologys.
